description: This Java class defines the OrderGroupAttribute, which is a user-defined attribute associated with OrderGroup entities within the OpenMRS system. It extends BaseAttribute and implements Attribute, providing getter and setter methods for its ID and associated OrderGroup.

classes.name: OrderGroupAttribute
classes.description: A value for a user-defined OrderGroupAttributeType stored within an OrderGroup, extending BaseAttribute and providing methods for ID and owner management.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of this OrderGroupAttribute.

methods.name: setOrderGroupAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this OrderGroupAttribute.

methods.name: setOrderGroup
methods.description: Associates this attribute with a specific OrderGroup.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the ID of this attribute, as required by OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this attribute, as required by OpenmrsObject.
